external_sources.read_scope: Memory work_mem hash and concurrent operation passages
external_sources.supported_claim: Memory budget multiplies across operations and sessions; hash multiplier matters
external_sources.not_established: Reason for historical failure or optimal production configuration

external_sources.read_scope: JSON type design and indexing overview
external_sources.supported_claim: JSONB supports appropriate indexing but query/document design still matters
external_sources.not_established: Need for universal JSON schema or any measured BuilderAd index bottleneck

external_sources.read_scope: Profiling architecture bundle splitting lists and reactivity passages
external_sources.supported_claim: Measure actual build; lazy-load and list/reactivity optimization are context-dependent
external_sources.not_established: Current BuilderAd slowness or need to replace SPA

external_sources.read_scope: Vue query cancellation and default behavior passages
external_sources.supported_claim: Cancellation needs signal consumption; unused query may otherwise populate cache
external_sources.not_established: Server mutation rollback or tenant authorization from cancellation

external_sources.supported_claim: Queue timeout must leave safety margin before retry visibility; after-commit dispatch timing
external_sources.not_established: Exactly-once provider effects or actual live worker configuration

external_sources.read_scope: Persistent request/container injection and memory leak passages
external_sources.supported_claim: Long-lived workers require request-state and memory discipline
external_sources.not_established: Octane is deployed or improves BuilderAd latency

external_sources.read_scope: Pooling modes and SQL feature support table
external_sources.supported_claim: Session/transaction/statement modes differ; protocol prepared plans need max_prepared_statements support
external_sources.not_established: Automatic PID/XID and authority-role compatibility for BuilderAd

external_sources.read_scope: Selected introduction structured output tools and fake-testing passages
external_sources.supported_claim: First-party multi-provider tools and structured-output SDK is a candidate; fakes can generate schema-shaped data
external_sources.not_established: SDK installed or semantic model quality privacy entitlement and current source rights

external_sources.read_scope: Excessive agency overview and mitigation direction
external_sources.supported_claim: Limit model tool agency and keep consequential effect authority controlled
external_sources.not_established: Validated BuilderAd vulnerability or proof defenses already implemented
